noise_diagnostic.summary_text:

Score moyen de proxy de variance: 0.747 (échelle 0-1)
Score maximum: 0.750, Score minimum: 0.731

TOP 3 FLUX AVEC SIGNATURE CSD:
  1. fliprate (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 13.38 vs bruit blanc 0.07
     - Hurst max: 1.099, Pente FFT: -1.208
  2. flip (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 13.38 vs bruit blanc 0.07
     - Hurst max: 1.099, Pente FFT: -1.208
  3. energy (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 11.36 vs bruit blanc 0.07
     - Hurst max: 0.913, Pente FFT: -1.014

BOTTOM 3 FLUX (BRUIT BLANC):
  1. magnetization (score: 0.750)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.733
  2. localvar (score: 0.750)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.799
  3. susceptibility (score: 0.731)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.892
